'''Imperial Trooper Guard''' is a [[Dark]] [[Character]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].

Title

帝国軍警備兵員

Card Text

移動できない。＊攻撃時は、戦闘力＝０で、防御時は、戦闘力＝４となる。

Lore

''戦術や武器に長けたエリート兵士。デス・スター配属のタジス・ドゥアミンなどがその典型例で、重要拠点に配置されている。''

Translation of Japanese Text

'''Title:''' Imperial guard personnel. '''Card text:''' Cannot move. *When attacking, power = 0; when defending, power = 4. '''Lore:''' Elite soldiers skilled in tactics and weapons. Tajis Durmin, assigned to the Death Star, is a typical example; they are stationed at important locations. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The English lore specifies guarding key areas of the Death Star; the Japanese says they are stationed at important locations, while identifying Tajis Durmin as assigned to the Death Star. The Japanese game text uses the shorter expressions ‘when attacking’ and ‘when defending’ for the English printing's offensive and defensive battles.

Notes

Japanese-language printing of [[Imperial Trooper Guard]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 97. '''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing'''
'''Baniss Keeg''' is a [[Dark]] [[Effect]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].

Title

バニス・キーグ

Card Text

どちらか選ぶこと。１：パイロットでないキャラクター（ドロイドを除く）に配備して、パイロット［パイロットアイコン］技能を持たせる。そのキャラクターの操縦する宇宙船は、戦闘力＋２になる。２：パイロットキャラクターに配備して、そのキャラクターの操縦する宇宙船の戦闘力をさらに＋１する（「意識操作」の影響を受けない）。

Lore

''デュロスは、優れた宇宙船乗りやエンジニアとして知られた種族で、多くのものが帝国のために働かされている。中にはバニス・キーグのように、深宇宙での任務のために、パイロットたちを訓練しているものもいる。''

Translation of Japanese Text

'''Title:''' Baniss Keeg. '''Card text:''' Choose one. 1: Deploy on a non-pilot character (except a droid) to give that character pilot skill. A starship that character pilots has power +2. 2: Deploy on a pilot character to add a further 1 to the power of a starship that character pilots. (Not affected by ‘Mind Manipulation’.) '''Lore:''' Duros are a species known as accomplished spacefarers and engineers, many of whom are forced to work for the Empire. Some, like Baniss Keeg, train pilots for missions in deep space. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese identifies the two deployment options by number and says the second adds a further 1 to the piloted starship's power. The English says the second option adds 1. The Japanese uses the title 意識操作 for the card named Alter in the English printing.

Notes

Japanese-language printing of [[Baniss Keeg]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].[https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/showcase/miscellaneous/star-wars-ccg-japanese-premiere/imagegallery/29544 Japanese Premiere collector image gallery], PSA.

Title

R1-G4（アーワン・ジーフォー）

Card Text

大型艦に乗っているなら、戦闘力と航行速度に＋１する。また、その宇宙船は耐：損耗＜３を得る。大きすぎて宇宙戦闘機には乗せられない。

Lore

''普及した旧式操縦ドロイドで、今でも大型の宇宙船や貨物船で使用されている。マークII・リアクター・ドローンの外殻に身を包む。所有者が捕えられ、R1-G4は廃棄された。''

Translation of Japanese Text

'''Title:''' R1-G4 (Arone-Geefour). '''Card text:''' If aboard a capital ship, adds 1 to power and travel speed. That starship also gains immunity to attrition < 3. Too large to be placed aboard a starfighter. '''Lore:''' A widespread older-model piloting droid still used on large starships and freighters. Encased in the shell of a Mark II reactor drone. R1-G4 was discarded after its owner was captured. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese lore describes an older piloting droid used on large starships and freighters; the English describes an old-model astromech used on capital starships and large freighters. The Japanese refers to the reactor drone's shell; the English describes it as armored.

Notes

Japanese-language printing of [[R1-G4 (Arone-Geefour)]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].[https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/showcase/miscellaneous/star-wars-ccg-japanese-premiere/imagegallery/29544 Japanese Premiere collector image gallery], PSA.

Title

ジェック・ポーキンズ

Card Text

操縦する宇宙船の戦闘力に＋２。レッド６を操縦していれば、さらに回避値が＋１され、戦闘運命数を引けない場合に１枚だけ引ける。

Lore

''ヤヴィンの戦いでレッド６を操縦する。掃射攻撃を得意とする。ティアフォン反乱軍前哨基地で、イエローエース中隊に属していた。元はベスティン星系の独立貿易商人。''

Translation of Japanese Text

'''Title:''' Jek Porkins. '''Card text:''' Adds 2 to the power of a starship he pilots. If piloting Red 6, its maneuver is increased by 1 and he may draw one battle destiny if unable to draw one. '''Lore:''' Piloted Red 6 in the Battle of Yavin. Specializes in strafing attacks. Served in the Yellow Aces squadron at the Tierfon Rebel Outpost. Formerly an independent trader from the Bestine system. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese lore explicitly says he was formerly an independent trader. The English says he is a free trader from the Bestine system. The game text expresses the same listed bonuses in different wording.

Notes

Japanese-language printing of [[Jek Porkins]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 97. '''Ion Cannon''' is a [[Dark]] [[Weapon]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].

Title

イオン砲

Card Text

２フォース消費して、「スター・デストロイヤー」に配備する。１フォース消費して起動する。運命数を引く。（運命数＋２）＞目標の装甲値か回避値ならば、目標の全ての武器はロストし、装甲値と回避値と航行速度は全て０になる。

Lore

''イオン化エネルギーを発射する。敵目標の武装、エンジン、コンピュータなどに広範な被害を与え得る。対トラクター・ビーム防御を無効化する。''

Translation of Japanese Text

'''Title:''' Ion cannon. '''Card text:''' Spend 2 Force to deploy on a Star Destroyer. Spend 1 Force to activate it. Draw destiny. If destiny + 2 is greater than the target's armor or maneuver, all of the target's weapons are lost, and its armor, maneuver, and travel speed all become 0. '''Lore:''' Fires ionized energy. It can cause extensive damage to an enemy target's weapons, engines, computers, and other systems. Disables defenses against tractor beams. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese text says armor, maneuver, and travel speed all become 0. The English printed text says armor or maneuver becomes 0, and hyperspeed becomes 0. The Japanese wording says to spend 1 Force to activate the weapon; the English says it may target using 1 Force.

Notes

Japanese-language printing of [[Ion Cannon]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].[https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/showcase/miscellaneous/star-wars-ccg-japanese-premiere/imagegallery/29544 Japanese Premiere collector image gallery], PSA.

'''Timer Mine''' is a [[Dark]] [[Weapon]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].

Title

タイマー地雷

Card Text

自分の地雷敷設ドロイドがいる位置カードの相手の側に配備する。次の自分のターンに「爆発」する。運命数を引く。そこにいる相手のキャラクターが運命数の数だけ即座にロストする（誰をロストするかは敵が選べる）。その時点でタイマー地雷もロストする。

Lore

''地雷敷設用ドロイドによって仕掛けられる時限式の爆弾。鉱脈やスパイス鉱山の爆破用に開発されたが、軍用に改造されている。''

Translation of Japanese Text

'''Title:''' Timer mine. '''Card text:''' Deploy on the opponent's side of a location card where one of your mine-laying droids is present. It ‘explodes’ on your next turn. Draw destiny. That many opposing characters there are immediately lost; the opponent may choose who is lost. The timer mine is also lost at that point. '''Lore:''' A timed bomb set by a mine-laying droid. Developed for blasting ore veins and spice mines, it has been modified for military use. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese says to deploy at a location card and that the mine explodes on your next turn. The English specifies a site and the beginning of your next turn. The Japanese says the opponent chooses the characters lost; the English says their owner chooses.

Notes

Japanese-language printing of [[Timer Mine (Dark)]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].[https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/showcase/miscellaneous/star-wars-ccg-japanese-premiere/imagegallery/29544 Japanese Premiere collector image gallery], PSA.

'''Wioslea''' is a [[Light]] [[Character]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].

Title

ワイオスリー

Card Text

自分の支配フェイズの間、１フォース消費して、同じ位置カードにいる相手のビークルまたはドロイドを対象にして“購入”してよい。運命数を引く。運命数＞対象の運命数ならば、対象の配備コストと等しいフォースを“支払って”（消費して）、その対象を手にいれる。

Lore

''ルークのランドスピーダーを買ったスペースポート・スピーダーズのヴーヴリアン女性。ジャバ・ザ・ハットに1000クレジットの借金があるギャンブラー。多くの言語を話す。''

Translation of Japanese Text

'''Title:''' Wioslea. '''Card text:''' During your control phase, you may spend 1 Force to target an opponent's vehicle or droid at the same location card for ‘purchase.’ Draw destiny. If it is greater than the target's destiny number, ‘pay’ (spend) Force equal to the target's deploy cost and obtain that target. '''Lore:''' A Vuvrian woman of Spaceport Speeders who bought Luke's landspeeder. A gambler who owes Jabba the Hutt 1,000 credits. Speaks many languages. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese calls the amount owed a debt; the English identifies it as a wagering debt. The Japanese describes obtaining the target after paying its deploy cost; the English says to take the target.

Notes

Japanese-language printing of [[Wioslea]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 97. Title

タンブリス中尉

Card Text

彼が操縦する宇宙船には配備コスト－１で宇宙船用兵器が配備できる。彼が操縦する宇宙船は戦闘力が＋２されるが、回避値が－１される。

Lore

''負傷して出撃任務を解かれた元戦闘機パイロット。デス・スターの戦術士官である。優れた戦略家で、帝国軍の宇宙戦闘機の指揮を専門としている。''

Translation of Japanese Text

'''Title:''' Lieutenant Tanbris. '''Card text:''' Starship weapons may be deployed at deploy cost −1 on a starship he pilots. A starship he pilots has power +2 but maneuver −1. '''Lore:''' A former fighter pilot relieved of flight duties after an injury. He is a tactical officer on the Death Star, a skilled strategist who specializes in directing Imperial starfighters. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese text applies the maneuver reduction to a starship he pilots. The English printed card applies it to a starfighter he pilots.

Notes
